notes.title: PLAYTEST TOMORROW!!!
notes.content:
[h2]PLAYTEST TOMORROW 🔥 [/h2]

We'll be kicking off our Second playtest, featuring:

[list]
[*] [b]The first glimpse into our story progression.[/b]
[*] [b]Multiple Difficulties[/b]
[*] [b]Permanent Upgrades and Unlockables.[/b]
[*] [b]Brand new UI[/b]
[*] [b]Tofu 🐺[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227059/7dd291aaf5a88e29e73478d6e39e786f38364710.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227059/28df31a70a0e8459ae31fb6447ad5763f8ea8991.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227059/495c77b4b9c9260ba450508235654113489a2f7a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227059/d4d6041a0b24e9a5b57fc80256930c24ea60af7a.png[/img]


[h3][b][url=discord.gg/KernelHearts]Join our Discord [/url][/b]to apply, all of the devs are in there, we love answering your questions. 
[/h3]

There will also be a forum to provide feedback. This is very important to us, as we want to shape the game into something really cool. We've been developing the game for a while, and we don't want to get lost in the sauce.
